page_title: IPS 1-1 LEI | Ipswich v Leicester 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' Leicester are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
90+7' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) takes the corner kick, but Arijanet Muric reads it well and stops the effort.
90+4' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
90+3' The resulting set piece from Leicester is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Leicester are awarded a corner kick.

90+2' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Arijanet Muric makes a great save to stop his effort.
90+1' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' George Hirst (Ipswich) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tim Robinson ignores the protests.
88' The corner is swung in but Leicester can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' The foul by Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tim Robinson.

87' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Leicester will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordan Ayew (Leicester) comes onto the pitch so that Victor Kristiansen can be given a rest.

86' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
84' Arijanet Muric (Ipswich) gets booked for the first time in this match.
84' The current number of corner kicks is 4:2.
81' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) gets a yellow card, off the field.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Wes Burns (Ipswich) is coming onto the pitch as Omari Hutchinson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Kieran McKenna has decided to substitute Conor Chaplin and he is replaced by Jens Cajuste (Ipswich).
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) coming on for Ricardo Pereira.
80' Wonderful movement by Leicester. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

77' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Tim Robinson shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
77' Total attempts – 14:7.
75' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement. Ipswich win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
75' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Liam Delap is replaced by George Hirst (Ipswich).
74' It is time for a substitution. Jack Clarke (Ipswich) is on for Sammie Szmodics.
73' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Leicester, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

73' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Leicester are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
72' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tim Robinson who sees an offensive foul.
71' Steven Cooper has decided to make a change. Kasey McAteer (Leicester) replaces Stephy Mavididi.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) will replace Wilfred Ndidi.
70' A poor mid-range free-kick by Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
68' The game is interrupted now, Leif Davis (Ipswich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
67' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Ipswich have a free kick from a promising distance.
66' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

64' Harry Winks (Leicester) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Arijanet Muric makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
63' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
63' Ipswich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
61' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
59' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) was probably a bit loose with his words to Tim Robinson, who decides to show him a yellow.
58' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
55' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Leif Davis (Ipswich) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Samy Morsy. The score is 1:0.
54' 1:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
51' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) commits a foul and Tim Robinson immediately signals a free kick.
49' Rough tackle by Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.

44' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Mads Hermansen and the score remains the same.
43' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mads Hermansen is quickest to intercept the ball.
41' Wonderful movement by Ipswich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
38' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

37' Leicester slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
34' Leif Davis (Ipswich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

34' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Ipswich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

31' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
30' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

30' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee blows his whistle, Ipswich are awarded a corner kick.

30' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
28' Ipswich showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
26' Tim Robinson blows his whistle. Liam Delap (Ipswich) commits a foul after dangerous play.
23' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
22' A yellow card for a tackle by Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester). Tim Robinson doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
21' Ipswich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

21' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Ipswich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
20' Leif Davis (Ipswich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
20' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Ipswich will take a corner.
19' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) takes it short.
19' Leicester are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Leicester get a corner.
17' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.

15' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Arijanet Muric thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
14' Leicester are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

11' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.

9' He should have done better. Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) is afforded space to connect with a Omari Hutchinson cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
8' Harry Winks (Leicester) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

8' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Arijanet Muric easily deals with the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Leicester will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Leicester seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
4' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score.

1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Leicester are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Leicester will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tim Robinson.
